title: Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential
abstract: arXiv:2610.01633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. translated_title: 透过量级势的视角看神经网络中的泛化
translated_abstract: 解释神经网络中的泛化与训练动态仍然是一个挑战，目前已有多种方法被开发用于研究这些现象的不同方面。在本文中，我们引入了“量级势”这一概念——一个基于度量量级理论的量——它反映了一个任意点被给定集合所代表的程度。我们发现这个基本量可以被应用于考察神经泛化中的多种特征。在logit层上计算得到的、相对于某个类别与相对于整个数据集的量级势之比，能够揭示该点的表示信息。在实验中，我们发现单个训练点的这些比值与Feldman记忆分数相关。跨点聚合的量级势比值能够检测决策边界中的结构性变化，并为模运算中的grokking（顿悟）现象提供一种几何指标。
tldr: 本文提出基于度量量级理论的“量级势”新概念，通过logit层上类内与全数据集的量级势之比来刻画样本的表示情况，实验表明该比值与Feldman记忆分数相关，并能检测决策边界的结构变化、为模运算中的grokking现象提供几何指标。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "magnitude potential," a quantity rooted in metric magnitude theory, and shows that the ratio of class-wise to whole-data magnitude potential at the logit layer correlates with Feldman memorization scores, detects structural changes in decision boundaries, and provides a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic.
